Universal artifact-ingress law: when canonical bytes already exist (uploaded image/file, local artifact, Git blob, generated binary), workers must never manually transcribe/reconstruct those bytes through model-authored base64/text chunks. Compute and record a source digest first, use a binary-safe or exact-byte transport, read back the stored artifact, and verify byte count/digest equality before CI, release, or downstream transformation. If the available transport cannot preserve exact bytes, stop that transport path and route through an approved binary-safe intake rather than guessing/retyping. Chunking is allowed only as a transport mechanism over machine-derived exact bytes with deterministic ordering and final digest verification. Teach this rule in relevant source/integration/release skills and test exact-byte mismatch rejection.

rows.original_queue_acceptance: Relay 1.9.9 must still pass the existing consumer-visible MCP App card gate: a normal Relay tool call in an ordinary ChatGPT conversation must visibly mount the intended UI, not merely register resources/metadata or return structuredContent. Separately, the Inspector QA surface must implement the user-approved Figma node 59:115 review instrument as the visible card: ~450px default width, compact single-column composition, project pill, progress, one question/reason, binary answer surfaces, note field, and no persistent chrome (no inspector masthead, move/minimize/close buttons, preview/capture status rows, flow badge, previous/next row, separate Overall UI, technical details, save footer, or visible resize handle). The card must autosave, be draggable from non-interactive card regions, resize responsively through invisible edge/corner hit zones, remain clamped on viewport resize, and dock to any viewport edge leaving only a thin real card edge visible. A docked edge gives a restrained occasional idle wiggle plus one return wiggle after meaningful pointer inactivity; prefers-reduced-motion removes the wiggle. The docked edge adapts contrast to the content beneath it: soft off-white glow over dark content, near-black shadow over light content, and a conservative dual-contrast fallback when tone cannot be known. Captured image/video surfaces may sample luminance when safe; live cross-origin previews use an optional postMessage tone handshake and must degrade safely if unavailable. Inspector's review surface behaves like Field's canvas without importing Field's editor runtime: regular wheel/two-finger pan, Ctrl/Cmd+wheel or trackpad pinch zoom at the pointer, middle-mouse pan, Space+drag pan, initial fit-to-view, GPU transforms, and responsive reclamping. Live embeddable previews are the primary QA surface; video then image are fallbacks/evidence. The live page must receive pointer, keyboard, forms, scrolling and navigation normally, with Inspector camera gestures not stealing ordinary page interaction. Full-screen exit is owned by the viewport, not the review card: Escape, browser Back/history state, and a small viewport-only reveal affordance near the safe corner provide exit paths. Existing evidence identity, autosave persistence, deterministic QA gates and live-preview resolver/session contracts remain canonical; do not create a second evidence store. Inline ChatGPT cards must also be able to show existing Inspector QA evidence that Relay already captured: when a verification result or selected evidence record has an authorized screenshot URL/evidence ID, the compact card may render that screenshot directly inside the card with a clear QA/evidence caption and exact evidence identity. This is reuse of canonical stored evidence, not a new capture and not a second evidence store. The card must not invent or substitute images; it must degrade cleanly to the text/status card when no image is available or the host cannot load it. The MCP App resource CSP must explicitly allow only the Relay-controlled image origins required for these QA screenshots, following the current Apps SDK resource-domain contract.

The live page must receive pointer, keyboard, forms, scrolling and navigation normally, with Inspector camera gestures not stealing ordinary page interaction. Full-screen exit is owned by the viewport, not the review card: Escape, browser Back/history state, and a small viewport-only reveal affordance near the safe corner provide exit paths. Existing evidence identity, autosave persistence, deterministic QA gates and live-preview resolver/session contracts remain canonical; do not create a second evidence store. Inline ChatGPT cards must also be able to show existing Inspector QA evidence that Relay already captured: when a verification result or selected evidence record has an authorized screenshot URL/evidence ID, the compact card may render that screenshot directly inside the card with a clear QA/evidence caption and exact evidence identity. This is reuse of canonical stored evidence, not a new capture and not a second evidence store. The card must not invent or substitute images; it must degrade cleanly to the text/status card when no image is available or the host cannot load it. The MCP App resource CSP must explicitly allow only the Relay-controlled image origins required for these QA screenshots, following the current Apps SDK resource-domain contract.
